en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified complex with round towers and high defensive walls, labeled as Castello del Buon Consiglio. The castle sits at the edge of a town with a road curving around the base of the walls, a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress, tall trees on the right, and mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed captions identify the site and city, and there is a handwritten signature at the bottom margin.
